items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She’s married to Lester Connors, you know, the basketball coach.

ctx.x: He had the namesake didn’t he?

And my daughter lives here in New York. As a matter of fact she lives in the same building here. She retired from IBM. She’s in real estate now and that’s, you know, the name of the game. My granddaughter just told us she’s going to have twins. She’s married to Lester Connors, you know, the basketball coach.
